Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] had '''her own office''' in her capacity of member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Leland Holiday">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=870#15778940|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-10-12|time=6:13 PM}}</ref> the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] had become in important figure in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and, as such, she occupied a private office in one of the Alliance's bases. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], around the time of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]], Organa and her [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] received a transmission from [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of the Alliance hero [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], while they were working in the office.<ref name="SWHS" />

==Layout==
The office of Princess Organa was rather spartan, containing only a desk, a chair, a personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]] and a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]. The walls and the desk itself were painted in stern nuances of [[Color/Legends|bluish-gray]].<ref name="SWHS">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''
